name: destill-prototype
description: Destill — Sculpted Light. Locally runnable design proposal prototype and its QA harness.

qa.note: QA scripts need a Chromium binary: set CHROME_PATH to one. In the original QA run, Chromium 153 was obtained from the npm package @sparticuz/chromium (registry.npmjs.org only), extracted to a scratch dir outside the repo. LD_LIBRARY_PATH and FONTCONFIG_PATH must include its lib/swiftshader/fonts dirs (see qa/README.md).
